selection: Eight non-STC filename prefixes MC MF MQ MS RTA SC SF SQ; within each prefix exclude already opened MC07, SC08, SC09; from initial directory metadata sort source Git SHA ascending, select first TWO. 16 total, not 16 authors: same original generator research dataset, some source families distinct mathematical puzzles.

registered_general_abstract_discoverer.unsat_theorem: From true original AST: preserve only conjunction-of-equalities, each integer ring polynomial formula over addition/subtraction/multiplication and integer constants. Reduce *both sides* modulo m with fresh residue variables 0..m-1. Drop ALL other unsupported original constraints/inequalities/negations/disjunctions, never strengthen originals. Thus any original integer solution maps to a model of modular abstraction. If Z3 UNSAT and independently cvc5 UNSAT on abstraction, ORIGINAL unbounded UNSAT. If SAT/UNKNOWN, no original conclusion.
registered_general_abstract_discoverer.source_shape_diagnose: Authenticate full raw original source SHA/bytes; parse native source original assertions Z3. Record count of original asserted conjuncts, actually sound polynomial equalities, unsupported dropped original constraints. No selective case omission. If no sound equality, abstain.
registered_general_abstract_discoverer.source_modular_no_oracle: Fixed candidate moduli and no source name/target labels in inference; first discovered modular obstruction only, if any. Candidate moduli searched ascending in supplied order. No gradient/neural/LLM.
registered_general_abstract_discoverer.direct: Original full unchanged SMT2 Z3 4sec and cvc5 4sec, same CPU; preserve numeric statuses/timeouts. Generic solver baseline only, not best modular classical because Direct can also run identical method.
registered_general_abstract_discoverer.no_falsely_claimed_SAT: Modular abstract SAT cannot infer original SAT, and no bounded miss is full UNSAT. Any source positive SAT from raw Z3 is direct evidence only.
registered_general_abstract_discoverer.case_fail_closed: If math AST unsupported, no proof; if CVC5 disagreement or timeout, no original UNSAT. Preserve all first source classifications.
registered_general_abstract_discoverer.bias: Metadata filename/prefix is known, but actual original SMT2 contents not read; selection not based on outcome or source truth. Distinct prefixes not distinct mathematician authors.

outcome_rules: Q3 cross-formula unsat count and raw Direct headroom, no strong claimed NEUMANN unique invention. ZERO is a valuable negative stop signal. Global Q1-Q7 OPEN.
